note: Merced Irrigation District's largest Lake McClure campground, with basic, water/electric and full-hookup sites on oak hills above the cove and out along a peninsula, plus a swim lagoon, two launch ramps, a marina and park-model cabins. Military, disabled and senior campers get $3 off. --Claude
summary: Barrett Cove (Merced ID, Lake McClure): Campspot-booked, 249 sites, $38 basic / $48 30-amp / $65 50-amp, full hookups to 50 A, free showers, dump, year-round (January bookable), open. Lakeview kept (J-loop peninsula open toward the lake), with a lakefront lead on the J-loop cove side for the reviewer. Pin ~650 m off at the marina parking -> ~37.6414,-120.2929.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT (stored, not --AWH). The J-loop pads (map sites J1-J30) sit along the peninsula road toward the South Launch Ramp, around 37.6402-37.6418,-120.2890 to -120.2845. Open dry grass with scattered oaks runs ~75-110 m from them down to the main lake's high-water line, which is a view and not within 50 m. The A-I and main loops are inland on oak hills. LEAD for the reviewer only (not written): the peninsula's SW road (around 37.6404,-120.2875) is at ~266 m on USGS EPQS, ~2 m above the 867-ft (264.3 m) full pool, and the cove arm's drawdown floor (257 m) is ~25 m away over open ground. The map draws J sites 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 13, 15, 17 and 18 on that cove side. All are sold nightly on Campspot. They could be lakefront at full pool, but no site positions were available to pin them (the map is schematic), so this was not upgraded.

PIN MOVE ~650 m: stored 37.6472,-120.2940 is at the L-loop / marina parking at the north end -> ~37.6414,-120.2929, the approximate site-weighted middle of the A-I, main and J loops on imagery and the map (no published site coordinates; reviewer's call on the exact point).
FEES: the posted schedule is still headed 'Fiscal Year 2026 (4/1/2025 - 3/31/2026)', but Campspot quotes the same $38/$48/$65 for May 2027.
SITES: the operator page says 249 sites and 'more than 200 choice campsites'; Campspot lists 212 RV/tent sites across its types. Wrote 249.
STATUS: campground open; the marina, upper store and north ramp are CLOSED, which matters for camp_store (the 'Marina Store & Cafe' is the store).
BOOKING: the only minimum stay is 2 nights on park-model cabins, not RV sites. Separate NICA race weekends (April 2-4 and 9-11, 2027) open for booking on Nov 30 and Dec 7, 2026.
